title: Герундий или инфинитив после глаголов (enjoy doing / want to do)

why: Когда два глагола стоят рядом, второй принимает особую форму: V-ing (герундий) или to + V (инфинитив). В русском оба варианта это просто «неопределённая форма» (любить читать, хотеть читать), а в английском выбор зависит от первого глагола, и его нужно запоминать.
formation: • Глагол + V-ing: I enjoy working here. She avoids driving.
• Глагол + to + V: I want to learn. He decided to leave.
• Отрицание: not ставим перед второй формой: I decided not to go. I enjoy not working.
• После предлога всегда V-ing: He is good at solving problems. Thanks for helping.
usage: 1. Только V-ing после глаголов: enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, keep, suggest, practise, give up, imagine, consider.
• I enjoy coding in the evening. (Мне нравится программировать вечером.)
• Do you mind opening the window? (Вы не против открыть окно?)
2. Только to + V после глаголов: want, need, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, learn, manage, refuse, afford, would like.
• We decided to start earlier. (Мы решили начать раньше.)
• She hopes to find a new job. (Она надеется найти новую работу.)
3. Оба варианта без разницы в смысле: like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin.
• I like to cook. = I like cooking. (Я люблю готовить.)
4. Оба варианта, но смысл меняется: stop, remember, forget.
• I stopped smoking. (Я бросил курить.) / I stopped to smoke. (Я остановился, чтобы покурить.)
• Remember to lock the door. (Не забудь закрыть дверь, это ещё предстоит.) / I remember locking the door. (Я помню, что закрыл дверь, это уже было.)
5. После глаголов let и make после дополнения идёт инфинитив без to: She let me go. They made him wait.
signalWords: Сначала смотрим на первый глагол. Планы, желания, решения (want, decide, hope, plan) обычно дают to + V. Чувства и действия-процессы (enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, keep) дают V-ing.
mistakes: ✗ I enjoy to read. → ✓ I enjoy reading. После enjoy только V-ing.
✗ I want going home. → ✓ I want to go home. После want нужен to + V.
✗ I'm interested in learn English. → ✓ I'm interested in learning English. После предлога ставим V-ing.
✗ She suggested to go out. → ✓ She suggested going out. После suggest идёт V-ing.
✗ I look forward to see you. → ✓ I look forward to seeing you. Здесь to является предлогом, значит нужен V-ing.
remember: Want, need, decide, hope, plan + to V; enjoy, mind, avoid, finish, keep + V-ing; после предлога всегда V-ing.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол в форме V-ing или to + V

items.prompt: I enjoy ___ (play) football on weekends.
She wants ___ (buy) a new phone.
We decided ___ (take) a taxi.
He avoids ___ (talk) about his salary.
They hope ___ (move) to a bigger flat.
Do you mind ___ (wait) for a minute?
I need ___ (finish) this task today.
She has finished ___ (write) the report.
I can't afford (a) buying (b) to buy a car.
He keeps (a) asking (b) to ask the same question.
We plan (a) visiting (b) to visit Spain next summer.
She suggested (a) going (b) to go to the cinema.
They refused (a) paying (b) to pay for the repair.
I'm good at (a) solve (b) solving puzzles.
He promised (a) calling (b) to call me back.
Thanks for (a) helping (b) to help me with my homework.

exercises.instruction: Смысл меняется: поставьте глагол в нужную форму

items.prompt: I'm tired. Let's stop ___ (have) a rest.
He stopped ___ (eat) sweets because of his health.
Remember ___ (send) the invoice tomorrow.
I remember ___ (meet) her at a party years ago.
Don't forget ___ (turn off) the lights when you leave.
I'll never forget ___ (see) the sea for the first time.
She stopped ___ (talk) when the boss came in.
On the way home I stopped ___ (buy) some bread.
I enjoy to cook for my friends.
items.answer: I enjoy cooking for my friends.

items.prompt: She decided going to the gym.
items.answer: She decided to go to the gym.

items.prompt: He is afraid of to fly.
We finished to work at six.
I look forward to meet you.
items.answer: I look forward to meeting you.

items.prompt: They want buy a house.
items.answer: They want to buy a house.

items.prompt: I decided to not tell him.
items.answer: I decided not to tell him.

items.prompt: Do you mind to open the window?
items.answer: Do you mind opening the window?

items.prompt: Я люблю программировать по вечерам.
items.answer: I like coding in the evenings. / I like to code in the evenings. / I love coding in the evenings. / I love to code in the evenings.

items.prompt: Мы решили начать новый проект.
items.answer: We decided to start a new project.

items.prompt: Она надеется найти хорошую работу.
items.answer: She hopes to find a good job.

items.prompt: Ты не против закрыть окно?
items.answer: Do you mind closing the window? / Would you mind closing the window?

items.prompt: Он продолжает задавать вопросы.
items.answer: He keeps asking questions. / He keeps on asking questions.

items.prompt: Я хочу выучить английский до конца года.
items.answer: I want to learn English by the end of the year.

items.prompt: Я бросил пить кофе по вечерам.
items.answer: I stopped drinking coffee in the evenings. / I gave up drinking coffee in the evenings.

items.prompt: Спасибо, что пришёл.
items.answer: Thanks for coming. / Thank you for coming.
